t: Look for the empty fourth plinth in Trafalgar Square. On 25 July 2013 a giant blue cockerel was unveiled here, called Hahn/Cock. It was made by the German sculptor Katharina Fritsch, who lives and works in Düsseldorf. The fibreglass bird stood just over four and a half metres high, and it was the sixth work to be shown on the plinth. It stayed until February 2015, and has since gone to Washington, where the National Gallery of Art received it as a permanent gift in 2021.
